PET FRIENDLY SPACES IN SOUTH GATE PARKS
The City of South Gate understands that we all want to bring our entire family, including our dogs to the park. A busy park is not always
the best place for a dog. To ensure that our four footed friends can also enjoy our City Parks, please remember the following rules.
SOUTH GATE PARK HOLLYDALE DOG PARK RULES
REGIONAL PARK 1. Park is open from dawn to dusk
2. Dogs must be leashed when entering or leaving the Dog Park
SOUTH GATE DOG PARK
3. Owners are required to pick-up and dispose of their dog’s feces
5400 Monroe Avenue
both in and out of the Dog Park
South Gate, CA 90280
4. Owners are solely responsible for their dog’s behavior and will be
liable for injuries or damage caused by their dogs
5. Owners use the park at their own risk. South Gate Parks &
Recreation Department is not responsible for injury or illness to
dogs or owners
6. South Gate Parks & Recreation Department reserves the right to
close the Dog Park for inclement weather, maintenance, repairs,
special events or when deemed necessary
1. Dogs are NOT ALLOWED inside South
Gate Park except on the outside trail
(sidewalks).
For the full list of Dog Park Rules please visit
2. Dogs must be on leash and in the
owners control at all times. www.cityofsouthgate.org
3. Please pick up after your dog.
